text: Attempt 9 begins: attempt 8's plan (ahead of attempt 6 for 20 years) + disaster.sh for every disaster + taxes held near 8% from 30,000 people.

Attempt 9 started. Attempt 8 was the best start yet (ahead of the record city for 20 years) until a fire I let run unwatched in 2038. Same plan, and now every disaster is handled in short watched bursts.
Jul 2002: loans #3-4: coal plant + 19 north pumps, second coal plant + north job district.
Zoo from cash; finance ordinances + City Beautification.
Jul 2004: loan #5: seaport job strip, east-edge homes with their power feeds; airport from cash.
Dec 2004: loans #6-7: south pumps, district 5; stadium + 4 fire stations from cash.
Feb 2006: loan #8: east coal plant + fire station, factory + home block by the seaport.
Feb 2008: loan #9: south mixed district (factory demand 1,290).
Jul 2008: south-east district + road links east and south from cash.
Loan 10: south coal plant and second seaport (joined to road row 55; its old extra road was not needed)
Feb 2010, 30,070 people. Took loan 10 for a power plant (power was down to 7% spare) and a second seaport for factory jobs.
